api_adaptations: RenderShape gains subpath_closed (parallel to subpaths) and stroke_closed: the C reference consumes path_subpath.closed and shape_stroke_closed to decide caps, joins and the dropped implicit fill-closing edge.

RenderShape.edges is the shape's own document-space edge slice (C doc->edges for one shape); subpath ranges index into it; transform is the forward local-to-document map and the stroke inverse is derived with the C svg_shape_affine_inverse formula.
StrokeStyle keeps dash_offset (validated finite as in C, otherwise unused) and crisp_edges (true returns Unsupported(CrispEdges) from render_shapes).

from_scene_shape additionally takes fill_rgba, the fill/stroke Paint tables and the shape's own subpath ranges and closed flags, because Shape alone carries paint table indices and the colour lives on the scene edge colours.
ViewMap::from_viewbox takes a ViewBox struct and Option<PreserveAspect> (None = xMidYMid meet, the C default when unset).

SceneFeatures (clips, opacity groups, masks, filters, text, animation overlay, SMIL) reports scene-wide deferred features as typed errors; ClipId has no public constructor, so the per-shape clip branch of from_scene_shape is covered through SceneFeatures.clips only.

offscreen_tile_size rounds points up (C render-frame region sizing uses ceil(size * zoom), zoom 1); render_offscreen is added so offscreen/golden paths have one entry point that cannot see a host scale.
The crate depends on vexel-geometry, vexel-raster and vexel-scene only (vexel-base is not needed).

C goldens were produced with svgworkbench --render-animation (native-size tile through write_tile_ppm, composited over white as rgb + 255 - alpha) because --render-frame composes onto a viewer checkerboard at the viewport size; the Rust tile is converted the same way before comparison.

Per-pixel center-only fast path, scanline index, fill scanline cache, boundary mask and the stroke acceleration grid are not ported: every pixel takes the 16-sample path with exact predicates, which is result-identical by construction (parity measured, see tolerance report).
